title: Seven Winters and One Short Wall
subtitle: 建筑居住 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 建筑居住（人与社会·历史、社会与文化）
meta: 主题语境：建筑居住（人与社会·历史、社会与文化）　|　核心词汇：extension　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 extension 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my father ① built an extension that no neighbour in the street would have measured, and he said the building was the whole of the winter. The ② extension, meaning the room itself and not the house, ran seven winters and stayed unmeasured in the book; an extension, he said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ extension in that street had the same short wall beside it, and the ④ extension at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the kitchen and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An extension, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; my father said the measuring is the part that fills seven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the extension was the whole of the line, meaning the extra length and not the room. The ⑥ extension, meaning the length and not any of that, is the only thing in a line that everybody waits for and nobody measures; extension, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a room and a length. He said the length is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ extension had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short wall. The ⑧ extension of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one street and seven winters of measuring; extension, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ extension I remember is the one measured in the plan, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the street. An ⑩ extension, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being measured; every extension, she said, is a length that has agreed to look like a room. She said the length was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 扩建部分；增建（指街上每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 扩建（指那一间本身，与整栋房子相对）
C. 固定搭配：build an extension 建一间扩建房
D. n. 扩建（指留给厨房的那一处）
E. n. 扩建（抽象总称，指一条街上的加建之事）
F. n. 扩建（指图纸上写到、被量过的那一处）
G. n. 延长；延伸（指一条线里人人都等却无人量过的那样东西）
H. n. 延长（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人量过的那样东西）

items.q: built an extension that no neighbour in the street would have measured
The extension, meaning the room itself and not the house
the extension at the far side
the extension was the whole of the line
the extension had become a line in a plan
The extension of the whole thing
An extension, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: build an extension 意为“建一间扩建房”，1964 年父亲建了一处街上没有一位邻居肯量过的扩建。
extension 意为“扩建”，指那一间本身而不是整栋房子，它经过了七个冬天而在簿子上没有尺寸。
extension 意为“扩建”，指街上每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一堵短短的墙。
extension 意为“扩建”，指留给厨房的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
extension 意为“延长、延伸”，指一条线里人人都等却无人量过的那样东西，叔叔说这段延伸就是那条线的全部。
extension 意为“延长”，指人人都等却无人量过的那样东西而不是那一间房，是线里人人都等、却无人量过的东西。
extension 意为“扩建”，指图纸上写到、被量过的那一处，到 1971 年这一处成了图纸里的一行。
extension 意为“扩建”，父亲一月写道，整件事的加建之事是一条街和七个冬天的量过。
extension 意为“扩建”，我记得的是图纸上量过的那一处，1974 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一处。
extension 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一处扩建是唯一会因为被好好量过而变得更好的东西。
